t: This is the SIS Building, also called the MI6 Building, at Vauxhall Cross on the south bank of the Thames, beside Vauxhall Bridge. It's at 85 Albert Embankment, and it has been the headquarters of the Secret Intelligence Service, the United Kingdom's foreign intelligence agency, since 1994. It was designed by Sir Terry Farrell, the British architect and urban designer. It is a government office building, so you can look at it from outside, but not go in.
